text_block_list.text:
Ah... Kawakami, *This Earth*!
Just what in the world happened!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Are you all right? Did something happen?
Are you all right? Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Actually... since yesterday, it feels like Kawakami and *This Earth* have been avoiding me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Whenever I try talking to Kawakami, she cuts the conversation short right away, and *This Earth* hasn't been seen anywhere...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It's more natural to think that Kawakami Princess took it and hid it away for some reason.
choice_data_list: For now, I'll try looking for them too.
For now, I'll try looking for them too.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ooh... Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaah! Oh you stupid, stupid, dummy carrot brain~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Gyaaah?! I-I-I'm so sorry! Showing such an unbecoming, un-princess-like display...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As Kawakami Princess flustered, my eyes fell upon her hands and feet. This was—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hieeee?!
choice_data_list: Could this be the reason you've been avoiding Pearl?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: H-H-How on earth do you know that~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...I was only trying to do something nice. While I was polishing her *This Earth* and mine—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: My hands slipped, and both *This Earth*s got mixed up together...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh...! Now I can't tell which one belongs to who at all~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes! *This Earth* is... a symbol of friendship given to me by Pearl-san!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hi! You must be my roommate, Kawakami♪
Let's get along great starting today♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, who might that pretty doll over there be?
...Pri... Fi?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Goodness gracious, is this your first time seeing PriFi?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: She is a lovely and pretty princess, as well as a strong, formidable fighter who takes her prince's hand into battle!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I look up to PriFi so much! Finding my prince and becoming a wonderful princess just like her—that is my dream!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
*Fantastic!!*
Very, very nice, Princess Kawakami!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I have a big dream of my own. *This Earth*—I'm going to become a worldwide Pearl...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: S-Sounds incredible somehow?! Please, you must tell me all about it!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Oh my! It's morning already?! But I haven't even talked nearly enough about our future dreams or PriFi yet—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fufu, we'll have plenty of time to talk from now on♪ Say, Kawakami.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'll give you *This Earth* too. In hopes that someday, you'll become a globe-trotting princess alongside your prince.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It's something so precious to Pearl-san, and to me as well... And yet—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Don't cry, girl! I heard everything!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You should have just told me from the start... The one on the left is my *This Earth*♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Inside *This Earth*, each owner's dreams and passion are packed tight.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Even if they look the same, each *This Earth* is one-of-a-kind in the whole wide world...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ever since the day we first met, Kawakami, we've shared our dreams countless times.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Pure and straightforward... you always remind me of the feelings I had when I was young.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Believing dreams will come true. Ready to charge anywhere for that sake. A princess giving me big courage—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: From Kawakami's *This Earth*, I can clearly feel that strength and warmth.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Waaaaah! I'm so sorry for not being honest with you earlier~~!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: *No problem*♪ Let's continue moving forward toward our dreams together!
choice_data_list: I'm so glad things worked out!
As expected of a *This Earth* specialist...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes... I owe you thanks as well.
choice_data_list: I only listened to her, that's all.
I only listened to her, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And thanks to that, I was able to learn Kawakami's feelings. *Very, very thank you*, Trainer♪
choice_data_list: If anything, I should be thanking you—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing them share their dreams gave me the energy to keep giving it my all too.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes, truly... To think you could tell *This Earth*s apart so easily.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Heh... I didn't get certified as a *This Earth* Appraiser for nothing♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: *This Earth*... is truly so profound...
